VI.description: Reads where the front panel of VI is on screen\2C for RemoteVI Translate Input.vi: geo.panelX/panelY = Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds left/top (the panel origin) and geo.clientX/clientY = the screen position of the window's client-area origin\2C computed as the negative of user32 ScreenToClient applied to the screen point (0\2C0). Also returns the window handle (Front Panel Window\3AOS Window\2C sign-extended I32 to I64 to U64). The server calls it once per message batch. An incoming error skips the work.

Control.description: The VI whose front panel window receives the input.

Node.fields: read+Front Panel Window\3AOS Window,read+Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds
Node.outputs: error out:pn.error out,Front Panel Window\3AOS Window:pn.Front Panel Window\3AOS Window,Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds:pn.Front Panel Window\3APanel Bounds

Call.inputs: hWnd:hw.unsigned 64bit integer,Screen X:k0.value,Screen Y:k0.value,error in (no error):pn.error out
Call.outputs: Client X:stc.Client X,Client Y:stc.Client Y,return value:,error out:stc.error out

Indicator.description: Panel origin and client-area origin in screen coordinates.
Native handle of the front panel window.
